2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Roads Highways works for Meridian Constructors & Co. completed 2022.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included a high water table requiring continuous
dewatering. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the department for additional
assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of restricted working hours imposed near the
adjoining school. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no
compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the approved
drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all
respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending Engineer.

3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Good. Workmanship was acceptable with minor rework at
two locations, and a joint inspection was held before final measurement. Materials were drawn from approved
sources and the test results filed with this office were within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, kerb alignment corrected over a 40 m stretch after joint inspection. Regarding site
safety, one first-aid case was recorded and closed with a toolbox briefing. The agency's conduct during the
contract is recorded as responsive throughout the defect liability period.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2022-05-22. All minor
observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the inspecting
authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the joint
measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend release of the
balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified by K.
Sinha, Superintending Engineer.
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on satisfactory
completion of the final inspection.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the contractor of any
obligations under the contract, including the defect liability period.
